title: Modernize color tone mapping and compact typography for charts & dense tables
creator: Ava Patel
description: Rationalize and publish a new set of design tokens focused on data-dense surfaces: 1) introduce a perceptually-consistent tone-mapping for chart palettes that preserves semantic differences at small sizes, 2) compress typography scale for compact tables and dashboards while keeping legible x-small text, 3) standardize spacing and corner-radius tokens for card/grid density variants, and 4) simplify shadow/elevation tokens to a 3-step system optimized for low-contrast surfaces. This ticket drives the design artifacts, accessibility checks, and migration guidance for engineers and product teams.
acceptance_criteria: New color palette tokens (semantic + tonal variants) published in Figma and tokens JSON
Typography scale updated with compact variant: token names, examples, and responsive rules
Spacing and radius tokens include 'condensed' and 'normal' variants with mapping table
Elevation simplified to three tokens (surface-0/surface-1/surface-2) with visual examples and CSS variables
Automated color contrast report for primary chart combinations showing AA/AAA where feasible
Migration doc and codemod guidance available for engineering (token rename map + fallback strategy)
Visual regression snapshots for charts/tables across density variants validated in QA
engineering_notes: Tokens should be released as v2 with a compatibility layer: old token names map to new tokens with console deprecation warnings
Provide codemod scripts to replace color token keys in components repo; target automated PRs for high-usage packages
Add unit tests for CSS variable fallbacks and snapshot tests for chart component rendering at 12px and 14px text sizes
Runtime feature flag to enable compact density so we can roll out progressively (console + dedicated)
